verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
One Church one faith one anthem raised
God and God alone

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
One cross one grace one name that saves
All praise to You belongs
All praise to You belongs

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
We lift You higher higher
God and God alone
Your name be louder louder
Than any other song

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You are forever seated on Your throne
You are forever God and God alone

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Who else can wash our sin away
God and God alone

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Who else can raise us from the grave
All praise to You belongs
Jesus all praise to You belongs

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
What could separate us
From this amazing love
What could say it's greater than our God

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Every knee will bow down
Oh every knee will bow down

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Yes ev'ry knee will bow down
Oh ev'ry knee will bow down
